title: 3 Myths About Money That Keep You Broke

segments.text: You’re believing lies about money that trap you.
Most think saving is all you need. It’s not.
Some say debt is always bad. That’s misleading.
You can't buy happiness, but money can buy freedom.
Question everything you think about money.
Want to break free from money myths? Follow for truth.

description: Many money myths keep you stuck in struggle. It's time to uncover the truth. Follow to redefine your relationship with money. 💸
